name: gap-agent-context-surface-headless
about: agent.runtimeContextSurface=user_message 与 agent.interactionProfile=headless（loadPilotConfig.ts:397-419，context/RuntimeContextSurface.ts，interaction/InteractionProfile.ts）：运行时上下文（cwd、模型、权限模式等）从系统提示词挪到用户消息；headless 下需要交互的工具（ask_user_question 等）是否声明、硬调时的结果。比较发给 provider 的请求。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  runtimeContextSurface: user_message
  interactionProfile: headless
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
